subject: The Criminal Mind: author questions re-cut under Ziggy's rule (originals stand by default); O closed; open S-f1, F, G, A, Q (delta v4)

attachments.description: interview file with a status on every question under the rule; O closed; O-f1 withdrawn
card delta v4: the re-cut for the site card, after v3

body: Ziggy's rule for author questions, given in chat today and now in the record: the author's original ideas stand by default; he is asked only where the script is silent, contradicts itself, or production must change something and his intent decides how. Applied: O is closed (one whole experience, not an episodic series; O-f1 withdrawn, since pieces shown to him are proofs, not a scope choice). Open for the author: S-f1 (the car) first, then F, G, A, Q. Notes for his glance, no answer needed: H, I, J, M, P. Withdrawn as written: D, E, L, N. R is the writer's; C (rating) moves to Ziggy. Card delta v4 carries the statuses after v3. Please apply the same rule to any future question set for an author.
